title: ngsRelate run sample-order sidecar
description: One sample ID per line, in the order ngsRelate's `a` and `b` indices reference. Lives next to relatedness.tsv as samples.txt. The atlas reads this when an analysis module needs to map a/b indices back to canonical sample IDs.
_layer_doc: Single-column TSV. The resolver-registry's tsv parser will return [{ sample_id: 'X' }, ...]. To get a flat array, analysis modules can .map(r => r.sample_id).

sample_id.description: Canonical sample identifier (CGA-format or Ind-format, must match cohort_sample_manifest).
